name: pulse
trans: n. (electronics) a sharp transient wave in the normal electrical state (or a series of such transients)

name: take one's temperature
trans: phr. to measure the temperature of one's body

name: blood pressure
trans: n. the pressure of the circulating blood against the walls of the blood vessels; results from the systole of the left ventricle of the heart…

name: have a blood analysis
trans: 血样分析

name: X-Ray film
trans: n. photographic film used to make X-ray pictures

name: asthma
trans: n. respiratory disorder characterized by wheezing; usually of allergic origin

name: heart disease
trans: n. a disease of the heart

name: obesity
trans: n. more than average fatness

name: overweight
trans: n. the property of excessive fatness
adj. usually describes a large person who is fat but has a large frame to carry it

name: depression
trans: n. a mental state characterized by a pessimistic sense of inadequacy and a despondent lack of activity

name: Yellow Fever
trans: n. caused by a flavivirus transmitted by a mosquito

name: diabetes
trans: n. a polygenic disease characterized by abnormally high glucose levels in the blood…

name: diabetic
trans: n. someone who has diabetes
adj. of or relating to or causing diabetes

name: treatment
trans: n. care provided to improve a situation (especially medical procedures or applications that are intended to relieve illness or injury)

name: remedy
trans: n. act of correcting an error or a fault or an evil; a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain

name: therapy
trans: n. (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)

name: massage
trans: n. kneading and rubbing parts of the body to increase circulation and promote relaxation

name: message
trans: n. a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled; what a communication that is about something is about

name: acupuncture
trans: n. treatment of pain or disease by inserting the tips of needles at specific points on the skin

name: operate
trans: v. direct or control; projects, businesses, etc.; perform as expected when applied

name: vaccinate
trans: v. perform vaccinations or produce immunity in by inoculation

name: prescribe
trans: v. issue commands or orders for

name: pharmacy
trans: n. the art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines,; a retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold

name: tablet
trans: n. a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing an inscription

name: pill
trans: n. something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size; a dose of medicine in the form of a small pellet

name: capsule
trans: n. a small container; a pill in the form of a small rounded gelatinous container with medicine inside

name: antibiotic
trans: n. a chemical substance derivable from a mold or bacterium that can kill microorganisms and cure bacterial infections

name: painkiller
trans: n. a medicine used to relieve pain

name: aspirin
trans: n. the acetylated derivative of salicylic acid; used as an analgesic anti-inflammatory drug (trade names Bayer, Empirin…

name: penicillin
trans: n. any of various antibiotics obtained from Penicillium molds (or produced synthetically) and used in the treatment of various infections and diseases

name: vitamin
trans: n. any of a group of organic substances essential in small quantities to normal metabolism

name: side effect
trans: n. a secondary and usually adverse effect of a drug or therapy

name: first-aid kit
trans: n. kit consisting of a set of bandages and medicines for giving first aid
